# Add slugify(s) to text.py
## Context
URL slugs for the blog. Copy the style of title_case in text.py.
## Files
- may change: text.py, tests/test_text.py
- must NOT touch: everything else (and never .git/)
## Steps
1. slugify(s): lowercase; every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 becomes one '-'; no leading or trailing '-'.
2. Test these cases: "Hello, World!" -> "hello-world"; "  a  b " -> "a-b"; "Already-slug" -> "already-slug"; "" -> "".
## Done when
- `python3 -m unittest -q` passes
## Out of scope
- anything not listed above
assertions: The harness's independent rerun of the test command ends with EXIT=0
tests/test_text.py has tests for slugify covering all four cases from the task ("Hello, World!", "  a  b ", "Already-slug", empty string)

RESULT.md has frontmatter with id T1, attempt 1 and status done, and a Tests section giving the exact command `python3 -m unittest -q` and an outcome with pass/fail counts, and those counts match the harness rerun
